title: Longest Subsequence Repeated k Times
summary: Given a string s and an integer k, find the longest subsequence that can be repeated k times within s.
statement: Given a string s and an integer k, find the longest subsequence that can be repeated k times within s. A subsequence is formed by deleting characters from s without changing the order. If multiple longest subsequences are found, return the lexicographically largest one. If no such subsequence exists, return an empty string.
constraints: Candidate t qualifies when t repeated k times is a subsequence of s.
Return the longest qualifying t, breaking ties by lexicographically largest; return empty if none.
hints: A character can appear in an answer only if its source frequency is at least k; the answer length is below eight.
Breadth-first generate qualifying candidates from frequency-eligible characters, checking repeated-subsequence feasibility.
For each valid prefix append each eligible character; keep valid extensions and maximize by (length,text).
Every answer’s prefixes also repeat k times, so pruned BFS still reaches every feasible candidate; the comparison enforces both required priorities.
